ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (lateral regions) to low-intensity black pixels (medial and speckled regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white-pigmented zones on the distal lobes; dense black mottling/speckling integrated into white fields; solid black triangular pigmentation at the fluke base/peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center; approximate 55-degree internal angle with a high vertical-to-horizontal bounding box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the continuous boundary; notable jaggedness and pixel-amplitude variance at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve; lobes exhibit a symmetric upward sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of small, high-contrast white circular spots on the black central surface; large high-contrast calcified masses on the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent diagonal dark linear mark on the left fluke's white pigmentation field; several smaller vertical rake marks near the left trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive reddish-brown and white biofouling/barnacle colonization on both the far left and far right distal tips of the flukes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical dark banding on the left lobe white field originating from a notch in the trailing edge.
